body:
January's Monthly Refresher Webinar will be a Website Management Overview. This is an excellent webinar to attend for anyone who is currently managing an HCP compliance program and who wishes to plan their program for 2016. It's also a good option for those who may have inherited responsibilities after their program was initially setup. There will be a live question and answer segment that we encourage you to participate in as well.

You can view this webinar Here
